handles.source: manual 2026-09-18 (owner: annotate the tab near the hinge)
handles.note: Lug / thumb tab on the lid top just in front of the rear hinge (lid mesh: faces at x -0.0106 / +0.0027 -> 13.3 mm thick, y 0.040-0.067, top z 0.291, the dome under it at z 0.277; the central cap in front tops at 0.286). Pinch across x with the pads' end 4 mm below the tab top (contact z 0.287: fingertips 7 mm beyond stay 3 mm above the dome); approach 20 deg from vertical toward the hinge as for the eyedvd ring (sideways layout, generation.lid_facing hinge_right). Lever 42 mm from the hinge axis. Not detected by artic_handles (protrudes only 12 mm).
